title: Add first-class `useQueries` hook for combining multiple queries
author: KXLAA
body_preview: RTK Query has no built-in way to run several queries and get a combined result (`loading`, `fetching`, `error`, `data`). Today the options are:  1. Call several `useXQuery` hooks and merge the results by hand. 2. Use `selectFromResult`. It only shapes a single query's result, so it can't span queries. 3. Handle a dynamic number of queries with `useLazyQuery` plus `Promise.all`, `initiate()` thunks...
